title: 全村抢20万拆迁款，我拒签后靠玉米赚麻了
style: The target video is a photorealistic live-action Chinese rural vertical short drama in 9:16 with cinematic composition, bright natural late-morning sunlight, a 35mm-equivalent lens look, warm earthy colours, crisp detail, and finely detailed faces with natural skin texture and sun-weathered complexions.

xiaokang.look: a 24-year-old Chinese man with a lean, earnest face, straight dark brows, clear bright eyes, a small mole on his right cheekbone, short neat black hair, wearing a plain light-blue cotton shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbows and dark-grey work trousers.

xiaokang.voice_sample: 我从小在黄谷村长大，村口这条路，我闭着眼睛都能走回家。
